metadata.title: PLOT OS v2 — 서울 소형·중형 상업용 빌딩 데모 참고 가정
metadata.warningKo: 검증 전 참고 가정 · 실거래·감정평가·대출 또는 세무 자문 아님
metadata.contextPeriod: 2024-2026 broad context; financing scenario intended for 2025-2026 demo
metadata.method: Model-authored estimates from general knowledge only, per user instruction; no browsing, reports, lender quotes or customer records consulted.
metadata.sourcePolicy: Every source name is a candidate for later verification, not a citation or evidence for a row. No report title, URL or publication date was invented.

confidenceMeaning.low: Unverified broad demo estimate or explicitly unknown; not measured accuracy, probability or investment confidence.

units.storedRateConvention: Ratios: 0.05 means 5%; multiply by 100 only for display.
units.pyeongConversion: 1 pyeong = 400/121 square metres (approximately 3.305785); pyeong = m2 x 121/400.

limitations: Bands pool heterogeneous submarkets, ages, frontage, floor mix and redevelopment options; they are not observed averages, confidence intervals or a 2024-2026 time series.
No verified November 2026 data or trend claim. Prime trophy, institutional towers, redevelopment land and distressed assets may fall outside bands.
Independent bands are screening envelopes, not jointly consistent observations. Never sample prices, rent, vacancy and cap independently and present the result as an evidenced deal.
Future generated assets must satisfy the separate 3-15 billion KRW demo price filter; not every land-area/price endpoint combination fits that filter.
Candidate reports may use institutional assets, different area bases or geography. Reconcile definitions before calibrating these small-building scenarios.

landPricePerPyeong.basis: Whole-property purchase consideration / land area in pyeong; includes building consideration, excludes acquisition costs and separately payable VAT.

gfaPricePerPyeong.basis: Same whole-property purchase consideration / total registered gross floor area in pyeong, including basement; not building-only construction value.

retail1fRentPerPyeongMonth.basis: Potential face monthly base rent per exclusive leasable pyeong for ordinary 1F retail; excludes deposit conversion, VAT, management fees, key money and incentives.

upperFloorRentPerPyeongMonth.basis: Potential face monthly base rent per exclusive leasable pyeong for ordinary 2F+ office/neighborhood-service space; same exclusions as 1F; excludes basement and rooftop.

vacancyRate.basis: Vacant exclusive leasable area / total exclusive leasable area at a point in time; synthetic physical vacancy, not credit loss, annual rent loss or an official district statistic.

capRate.basis: Year-1 forward unlevered NOI / whole-property purchase price before acquisition costs; NOI after vacancy and owner operating expenses, before financing, income taxes and capex.

loanInterestRate.notes: Nominal annual interest for illustrative secured senior commercial-building debt; 2024-2026 context only. Not a quote or a current November 2026 rate. Excludes fees, bridge/project loans and distress.

typicalLtv.notes: Illustrative loan / purchase-price funding ratio, subject to valuation, tenant-deposit deductions and debt-service approval. Not a regulatory maximum or lending entitlement.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
depositToMonthlyRentMonths.notes: Demo convention: refundable security deposit = contracted monthly base rent x months. Negotiated actual deposits vary. This is not a legal deposit-to-rent conversion interest rate.

acquisitionTaxRate.notes: Aggregate demo acquisition-related tax allowance of 4.6% as requested by PLAN. Not a verified statutory rate; legal basis, taxable base, surcharges, exemptions and purchaser/use-specific treatment are UNKNOWN.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
acquisitionBrokerageFeeRate.notes: Illustrative negotiated acquisition brokerage fee allowance before any service VAT; upper endpoint is a scenario input, not a statement of the legal fee cap.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
acquisitionMiscCostRate.notes: Budget allowance for registration, legal/scrivener work, diligence and similar closing costs; excludes acquisition tax, brokerage, financing fees, capex and separately applicable VAT. Itemized quote UNKNOWN.

loanOriginationFeeRate.notes: Illustrative upfront lender/appraisal/arrangement allowance applied once to initial loan principal; not an annual interest charge. No verified lender schedule.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
saleBrokerageFeeRate.notes: Optional future exit brokerage allowance, before applicable service VAT. Excludes capital-gains taxes, prepayment charges and other exit costs.

unknowns.notes: Actual transaction, rent, vacancy and loan observation dates/current November 2026 levels were not retrieved.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
unknowns.notes: Actual negotiated or legally applicable deposit/rent conversion rate is not supplied. Do not infer an annual yield from the deposit-month multiple.
Building/land VAT allocation, service VAT, business-transfer treatment and recoverability depend on the actual deal; not modeled by the simple acquisition allowance.
Actual taxable base and combined tax rate depend on purchaser, property/use and applicable law; 4.6% remains only a demo allowance.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
unknowns.notes: Actual property tax, insurance, repairs, management and nonrecoverable operating expenses require property evidence. Do not reverse-engineer an asserted rent roll from the cap-rate band.

sourceNames: 현지 공인중개사 확인 / 거래별 중개보수 견적
